## Type of change

- [ ] feat — new feature
- [ ] fix — bug fix
- [ ] refactor — code change that neither fixes a bug nor adds a feature
- [ ] perf — performance improvement
- [ ] docs — documentation only
- [ ] test — adding/fixing tests
- [ ] chore — tooling, deps, CI
- [ ] BREAKING CHANGE — requires migration / caller updates

## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows **Conventional Commits**
- [ ] Code follows `docs/CODING_STANDARDS.md`
- [ ] Tests added/updated and passing (`pnpm test`)
- [ ] Type-checks pass (`pnpm typecheck`)
- [ ] Documentation updated (API docs, README, or `docs/`)
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or `.env` files in the diff
- [ ] Migrations are reversible (up + down) if applicable
- [ ] Accessibility considered for UI changes
- [ ] Breaking changes noted in "Type of change" and described below
